id.description: A ref from get_transactions (T73508261946, T~... or C0869ae0a.2), or Schwab's activity ID (73508261946).

account.description: The account, as get_transactions takes it; needed only when neither the local history nor id tells it.

include_raw.description: Also return Schwab's JSON of the transaction, with account numbers masked, and a value of a key the server does not know withheld unless it is a time, a code, a number that cannot be an account number, or a number already masked.
